mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months indicates an easing monetary policy stance, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior three months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 6.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate revenue outlooks.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS have increased in the prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO below 100), supply chain disruptions and reduced industrial output lead to lower corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC for the regime is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past three months reflects expanding manufacturing and services sectors, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has increased over the prior three months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 900 thousand units signals weak residential construction and consumer confidence, reducing economic growth momentum and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST is below 900, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS has increased and UNRATE has decreased in the prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth rate exceeding 2% in the prior quarter), strong economic momentum supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2%, or the Rank IC for the regime is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
